description: Search focus tags (specializations within a role, e.g. "mobile-ios-android", "ml-ai", "devops", "security") using searchText input (required) and get their slugs. Use this to resolve a specialization into the focusTagSlugs the benchmark tools accept. Returns matching focus tags with their slugs. If this returns no matches, fall back to search-all, which searches every entity type and applies a fuzzy fallback. REQUIRED arguments: searchText.

searchText.description: Focus tag / specialization name to search for (e.g. "mobile", "ml", "devops").

name: search-focus-areas
